# View Transitions Implementation

This product gallery now features smooth, modern view transitions with the following capabilities:

## 1. Shared Element Transitions
- Product images morph smoothly from grid thumbnails to detail page hero images
- Uses `viewTransitionName` CSS property with unique identifiers per product
- 0.4s duration with smooth easing curve

## 2. Directional Page Navigation
- **Forward navigation** (grid → detail): slides left-to-right
- **Back navigation** (detail → grid): slides right-to-left  
- Detects browser history events to determine direction
- 0.3s duration with ease-out timing

## 3. Suspense Loading Transitions
- Skeleton screens fade out smoothly
- Content fades in with 0.3-0.4s animation
- Product info animates in after suspense resolves

## 4. Accessibility
- All animations wrapped in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`
- Users with reduced motion preferences get instant transitions (0.01ms)
- Follows WCAG 2.1 guidelines for motion sensitivity

## 5. Interactive Enhancements
- Product cards lift on hover with subtle shadow
- Smooth transitions for all interactive states

## Technical Implementation

### Dependencies
- `next-view-transitions`: View Transitions API integration for Next.js

### Key Files Modified
- `app/layout.tsx`: ViewTransitions wrapper + navigation provider
- `app/ViewTransitionProvider.tsx`: Client component for navigation direction detection
- `app/ProductGrid.tsx`: Shared element naming for thumbnails
- `app/product/[slug]/page.tsx`: Shared element naming for hero images
- `app/globals.css`: Transition animations and accessibility rules

### Browser Support
- Modern browsers with View Transitions API support
- Graceful degradation for older browsers (instant navigation)
- All functionality preserved without view transitions
